ordering: Older to newer within each numbered video collection; images unordered.
title_basis: Descriptive showcase titles, authorised by creator; original names retained.

videos.title: Minecraft: Glowing-Eyed Encounters
videos.description: Minecraft-style characters appear in close-ups and block-built scenery, with glowing eyes, a turquoise axe and strongly contrasting light. The sampled scenes place the black Farland avatar alongside blue and crowned characters.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Farland Avatars: Character Introductions
videos.description: A Minecraft-style character showcase introduces the black F-marked avatar and a blue avatar, includes a crossed-out future-character card, and closes on a smoky THE APEX title graphic.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: THE APEX: Avatar Showcase
videos.description: Black and blue Minecraft-style avatars are presented against simple backgrounds, followed by a crossed-out future-character card and a smoky THE APEX title. Framing and character scale vary across the sampled shots.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Minecraft Interiors: Scenes in Progress
videos.description: An unfinished Minecraft-style animation with indoor character scenes, a crowned avatar seated on a bench, rows of lever controls, and the black Farland avatar beside a lamp and in a bedroom setting. Presented as work in progress.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: THE APEX and Friends: Group Lineups
videos.description: Minecraft-style character portraits and group lineups appear against pale backgrounds, including a Farland avatar with a wanted poster, a THE APEX trio, and a separate group introduced with decorative lettering.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Minecraft Avatar Movement Showcase
videos.description: A dark-background character showcase combines individual poses, a lifted-knee movement, a close-up of a colourful sunglasses-wearing avatar, and a group composition with figures extending their arms.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: THE APEX: Yellow Trio Intro
videos.description: A short yellow-background intro frames the blue, black F-marked and crowned Minecraft-style avatars together, with bold white outlines and visible name labels for Armiya Fabix, Farland_Game and Alivexor.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: THE APEX: Creator Profile Cards
videos.description: Yellow-and-black profile cards introduce Farland Game, Alivexor and Armiya Fabix beside their Minecraft-style avatars. The supplied clip ends with the message that the next part is still being made.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Avatars in Changing Worlds
videos.description: A portrait-format edit moves between a pair of Roblox avatars, a sunglasses-wearing character against a red emblem, a bright transition and a lone avatar in a distant landscape.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Pink Backdrops and Lunar Light
videos.description: An orange-haired Roblox avatar appears against pink backgrounds before the sampled edit shifts to pale figures against a dark starfield and a large bright moon.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Sky and Spotlight Poses
videos.description: A portrait-format avatar montage combines a dark cloudy scene, brightly lit characters against sky and space-like scenery, and contrasting orange-haired and black-clad character poses.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: City Heights and Character Close-Ups
videos.description: The sampled shots combine an avatar among city towers, a warmly lit close-up of a cap-wearing character, a bright sunglasses portrait and a dark-haired avatar against clouds.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: City-to-Sky Avatar Edit
videos.description: A sunglasses-wearing avatar appears by city buildings and suspended against a bright sky, followed by poses of a dark-clad, cap-wearing character with mountains and clouds behind.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Arena Poses and Fiery Effects
videos.description: A red-accented, sunglasses-wearing avatar shares a blue arena with another figure. Overhead framing, a large round object, a fiery red effect and a dark character close-up vary the sampled imagery.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Hammer, Blade and Face-Off
videos.description: A sunglasses-wearing Roblox avatar poses with a large hammer and blade, faces a black-clad character, and appears in red-lit action compositions with dramatic backgrounds.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Character Montage Across Settings
videos.description: Group poses in an interior alternate with close-ups of a sunglasses avatar and a dark-haired character, then an orange-haired figure in a leafy outdoor setting.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Mangoes and a Yellow Cape
videos.description: A smiling, sunglasses-wearing Roblox avatar holds colourful mango-like fruit while wearing a yellow cape. The sampled edit alternates sandy rubble, a bright airborne pose and a warm gradient backdrop.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Mango Meme Face Remix
videos.description: A variation on the fruit-and-cape imagery replaces the avatar's face with exaggerated meme graphics, including a green horned face, across sandy, sky-lit and warm-gradient shots.

videos.software_basis: creator-reported; After Effects specified for final two main entries
videos.title: Roblox: Crossover Character Montage
videos.description: A longer portrait-format montage brings together spiky-haired and sunglasses-wearing figures, red crewmate-style characters, and a group of Roblox avatars surrounded by vivid green and yellow effects.
